text: Information and Communication Engineering is an engineering discipline based on information theory, electromagnetic field theory and signal processing, which studies the acquisition, transmission, processing and application of information. Its core task is to build a communication network of "human-machine-thing" interconnection and solve the problems of "how to efficiently transfer data" and "how to ensure the reliability of information". For instance, how 5G base stations can transmit high-definition video streams within milliseconds, how Beidou satellites can precisely locate through electromagnetic waves, or the attenuation and optimization of mobile phone signals between buildings. Compared with computer science, this major focuses more on "physical layer transmission" and "communication protocol design", and is the builder of the "information superhighway" in the digital age.
